description: SMB cyber-readiness controls — CSF 2.0 + CISA, searchable. The Ni Biashara cybersecurity shelf's SMB readiness layer: 24 small-business readiness controls mapped to NIST CSF 2.0 functions/categories and CISA's small-business guidance, each with why it matters, vendor-neutral do-this steps, done-when checks, cost band and its source. Filter by CSF function, business type or sequence priority. Defensive only. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

business_type.description: general, restaurant, retail, ecommerce, professional-services or health-clinic — general controls always apply (optional)

function.description: NIST CSF 2.0 function: Govern, Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond or Recover (optional)

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

priority.description: sequence band: do_first, do_next or do_later (optional)

q.description: free text over control titles, rationale and steps (optional)
